description: COMMENT IF EXISTS ON <object-type> ... IS '<text>' completes SILENTLY for every missing target (database, schema, table, column, the column's table, view, stream, task, warehouse, stage, function, procedure, user, role) and behaves exactly like the plain command when the target exists, read back through the same SHOW/DESCRIBE cells. All live-verified. Converted 1:1 from ddl/CommentIfExistsTest (now retired).

steps.sql: COMMENT IF EXISTS ON DATABASE cmt_ife_nodb IS 'Comment'
CREATE OR REPLACE DATABASE cmt_ife_db
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON DATABASE cmt_ife_db IS 'Updated comment'
SHOW DATABASES LIKE 'cmt_ife_db'
SELECT "comment" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
DROP DATABASE cmt_ife_db
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON SCHEMA cmt_ife_noschema IS 'Comment'
CREATE SCHEMA cmt_ife_schema
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON SCHEMA cmt_ife_schema IS 'Schema comment'
SHOW SCHEMAS LIKE 'cmt_ife_schema'
SELECT "comment" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON TABLE cmt_ife_notable IS 'Comment'
CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON TABLE users IS 'User table'
SHOW TABLES LIKE 'users'
SELECT "comment" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON COLUMN users.nonexistent IS 'Comment'
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON COLUMN cmt_ife_notable.name IS 'Comment'
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON COLUMN users.name IS 'User name'
DESCRIBE TABLE users
SELECT "comment" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) WHERE "name" = 'NAME'
CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON VIEW cmt_ife_noview IS 'Comment'
CREATE VIEW active_users AS SELECT * FROM users
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON VIEW active_users IS 'Active users'
SHOW VIEWS LIKE 'active_users'
SELECT "comment" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
COMMENT IF EXISTS ON FUNCTION cmt_ife_nofn() IS 'Comment'
